decision_rule: One-prompt GPU modes diagnostic only. Require hash-bound v10+diagnostic modes build and actual mapped libraries/model, official grant binding, widths 2 and 3 each normal rc0 PASS and explicit fault rc1 FAIL injected-fault. Each case must witness native strict partial acceptance, target mode1 and mode2, draft rewind, nonfault errors <= original baseline+1e-5 and fault differences >10x tolerance, finite numeric fields, no cutoff and reaped child. Stop on all four valid cases (PASS), or first missing/failed native control (UNKNOWN/futility), STOP or deadline. Smoke qualifies native model and all-library mapping only; no rollback, performance, full CAFE-4 claim follows from smoke. R7 uses rollback-isolation source af8bdd0e8261e200701ae9ad8fe5ed7a00070b0a0ab46d1a18d30737173bd1d4 and qualified HIP R7 executable f866bc5c5f4c293e8099211c644422727b56342ed417dea406106ba85e5ac1e8; snapshot mode stays zero through proposal/verification and changes only at rollback. Prior R6 UNKNOWN remains unchanged; fixed error gate 0.743863867, lower error is better, reference floor separate. No threshold relaxation. Each case and smoke require model/all six local libraries mapped plus two live per-child KFD/nonzero-VRAM samples; missing residency is UNKNOWN. Offload requested with -ngl 99. Failed-case diagnostics retain numeric measurements, native failure messages and individual predicates separately; they never qualify UNKNOWN as PASS.
